    Adds a single attachment row to dbo.udJHAAttachments for an EXISTING Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) form (SOF-1119), complementing postJHAForms (which can only attach files while creating a form) so the client can stage a file and attach it on "Save Changes" to the form it is already editing, instead of creating a duplicate form per upload. Accepts either application/json (default) or application/x-www-form-urlencoded/multipart form data. Required: formId (integer, id of the parent udJHAForms row, bound as sql.Int and validated as a positive integer within the SQL INT range 1..2147483647) and blobUrl (string, full Azure Blob URL on the configured storage account in the "jobs" container with no SAS query string, validated via validateBlobUrl kind:"file"). Optional: thumbnailUrl (string), fileName (string, derived from blobUrl's basename when omitted), contentType (string, MIME type), createdBy (string). The insert is guarded to the parent form's own Co and only fires when that form is still editable (Status 0=Draft or 1=Submitted — the same convention as deleteJHAAttachment, so an attachment cannot be added to an approved/locked form); no matching editable form returns 404 and nothing is inserted. On success, also best-effort mirrors the new file into udJobFiles (folder 'JHA'); a mirror failure is logged but never fails the request. Returns the newly created attachment row as a bare JSON object (not wrapped in message/record) with 201.

fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check user changelog
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          PR_BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # 1. List changed files. Diff locally against the merge-base instead of
          #    `gh pr diff`, which 406s on PRs whose diff exceeds GitHub's
          #    20,000-line API cap (large/stacked PRs hit this).
          merge_base=$(git merge-base "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA")
          changed=$(git diff --name-only "$merge_base" "$HEAD_SHA")
          echo "Changed files:"
          echo "$changed"
          echo

          # 2. Determine user-facing change.
          #    Include: src/features, src/shared, src/app, src/server
          #    Exclude: tests, *.md, .github, scripts, config files
          user_facing=$(echo "$changed" | awk '
            /^src\/(features|shared|app|server)\// {
              if ($0 ~ /\.test\./)              next
              if ($0 ~ /\.spec\./)              next
              if ($0 ~ /\.md$/)                 next
              if ($0 ~ /^src\/tests\//)         next
              print
            }
          ')
          if [ -z "$user_facing" ]; then
            echo "No user-facing files changed — auto-skip."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "User-facing files detected:"
          echo "$user_facing"
          echo

          # 3. Check skip signals
          labels=$(gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --json labels --jq '.labels[].name' || true)
          if echo "$labels" | grep -qi '^skip-changelog$'; then
            echo "Skip via 'skip-changelog' label."
            exit 0
          fi

          body_lower=$(echo "$PR_BODY" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
          if echo "$body_lower" | grep -qF '[skip changelog]'; then
            echo "Skip via '[skip changelog]' marker in PR body."
            exit 0
          fi

          # "N/A — pure refactor / test-only / docs / CI / internal tooling" checkbox checked
          if echo "$body_lower" | grep -qE '^\s*-\s*\[x\]\s*n/a'; then
            echo "Skip via 'N/A' checkbox in PR body."
            exit 0
          fi

          # 4. Verify CHANGELOG.site.json gained an entry. This is the file the
          #    /changelog page actually renders, so it is the gate. We count the
          #    entry objects by their required "summary" key across the WHOLE
          #    file: that's format-independent (reindenting the JSON can't fool
          #    it) and doesn't care where in the file the entry was added.
          count_entries() {
            # `|| true` so a file with zero "summary" matches yields 0 instead of
            # grep's non-zero exit, which under `set -euo pipefail` would abort the
            # whole script at the `base_count=$(...)` assignment — the bootstrap
            # case where the base branch has no CHANGELOG.site.json entries yet.
            { grep -o '"summary"' "$1" 2>/dev/null || true; } | wc -l | tr -d ' '
          }

          if ! echo "$changed" | grep -qx 'CHANGELOG.site.json'; then
            echo "::error::User-facing changes detected but CHANGELOG.site.json was not modified."
          else
            # Pinned to the PR's actual base commit, not a live branch ref —
            # `origin/$BASE_REF` would already contain this PR's own entry if the
            # check re-runs after merge, making both sides equal and producing a
            # false-positive failure. A missing base file (first introduction of
            # the file) counts as zero entries.
            base_file=$(mktemp)
            git show "$BASE_SHA:CHANGELOG.site.json" > "$base_file" 2>/dev/null || echo '[]' > "$base_file"

            base_count=$(count_entries "$base_file")
            head_count=$(count_entries CHANGELOG.site.json)
            rm -f "$base_file"

            if [ "$head_count" -le "$base_count" ]; then
              echo "::error::CHANGELOG.site.json was modified but gained no new entry (had $base_count, now $head_count)."
            else
              echo "CHANGELOG.site.json gained $((head_count - base_count)) entry/entries ($base_count -> $head_count)."
              exit 0
            fi
          fi

def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    args = [a for a in argv[1:] if not a.startswith("--")]
    if len(args) == 2:
        messages_path, out_path = Path(args[0]), Path(args[1])
        session_path = None
    elif len(args) == 3:
        messages_path, session_path, out_path = Path(args[0]), Path(args[1]), Path(args[2])
    else:
        print(__doc__)
        return 2

    data = json.loads(messages_path.read_text())
    session = json.loads(session_path.read_text()) if session_path else {}
    messages = data.get("messages") or []
    stem = out_path.stem
    assets = out_path.parent / f"{stem}.assets"
    assets.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    asset_prefix = f"{stem}.assets/"

    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    tokens = {"in": 0, "out": 0, "cacheRead": 0, "cacheWrite": 0}
    for m in messages:
        for b in m.get("content") or []:
            if isinstance(b, dict):
                counts[b.get("type", "?")] = counts.get(b.get("type", "?"), 0) + 1
        mm = m.get("metrics") or {}
        tokens["in"] += mm.get("inputTokens") or 0
        tokens["out"] += mm.get("outputTokens") or 0
        tokens["cacheRead"] += mm.get("cacheReadTokens") or 0
        tokens["cacheWrite"] += mm.get("cacheWriteTokens") or 0

    out: list[str] = []
    out.append(f"# Chat transcript — {stem}\n")
    out.append(
        "Verbatim session record, saved from the CLI session store "
        f"(`{messages_path.name}`). Nothing here is paraphrased: the system prompt, "
        "the user prompts, every assistant reasoning block, and every tool call "
        "with its full result are reproduced in order.\n"
    )
    out.append("## Session\n")
    out.append("| field | value |")
    out.append("| --- | --- |")
    rows = [
        ("session id", data.get("sessionId") or session.get("session_id")),
        ("source", session.get("source")),
        ("cwd", session.get("cwd")),
        ("workspace root", session.get("workspace_root")),
        ("started at", session.get("started_at")),
        ("last write to store", data.get("updated_at")),
        ("provider / model", f"{session.get('provider')} / {session.get('model')}"),
        ("status at snapshot", session.get("status")),
        ("messages", len(messages)),
        (
            "blocks",
            ", ".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in sorted(counts.items())),
        ),
        (
            "assistant tokens",
            "in {inp}, out {out}, cache read {cr}, cache write {cw}".format(
                inp=tokens["in"], out=tokens["out"],
                cr=tokens["cacheRead"], cw=tokens["cacheWrite"],
            ),
        ),
    ]
    for label, value in rows:
        if value not in (None, ""):
            out.append(f"| {label} | `{value}` |")
    out.append("")

    if session.get("prompt"):
        out.append("## Opening prompt\n")
        out.append(code_block(str(session["prompt"]), "text"))

    if data.get("system_prompt"):
        out.append("## System prompt\n")
        out.append("<details><summary>Full system prompt as sent to the model</summary>\n")
        out.append(code_block(data["system_prompt"], "text"))
        out.append("</details>\n")

    out.append("## Conversation\n")
    for idx, message in enumerate(messages, start=1):
        role = message.get("role", "?")
        out.append(f"### {idx}. {role}\n")
        meta_bits = []
        if message.get("ts"):
            meta_bits.append(fmt_ts(message["ts"]))
        line = emit_metrics(message)
        if line:
            meta_bits.append(line)
        if meta_bits:
            out.append(" · ".join(meta_bits) + "\n")

        for j, block in enumerate(message.get("content") or []):
            if not isinstance(block, dict):
                out.append(code_block(str(block), "text"))
                continue
            btype = block.get("type")
            if btype == "text":
                out.append(block.get("text") or "")
                out.append("")
            elif btype == "thinking":
                out.append("**🧠 thinking**\n")
                out.append(code_block(block.get("thinking") or "", "thinking"))
            elif btype == "tool_use":
                out.append(
                    f"**🔧 tool call — `{block.get('name')}`** "
                    f"(id `{block.get('id')}`)\n"
                )
                out.append(code_block(json.dumps(block.get("input"), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "json"))
            elif btype == "tool_result":
                out.append(
                    f"**📥 tool result — `{block.get('name')}`** "
                    f"(for `{block.get('tool_use_id')}`)\n"
                )
                out.extend(
                    render_result_content(
                        block.get("content"), assets, asset_prefix, f"{stem}-m{idx}-b{j}"
                    )
                )
            else:
                out.append(code_block(json.dumps(block, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "json"))

        bad = (message.get("metadata") or {}).get("invalidToolCalls")
        if bad:
            out.append(f"**⚠️ {len(bad)} invalid/rejected tool call(s) in this turn**\n")
            out.append(code_block(json.dumps(bad, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "json"))

    out_path.write_text("\n".join(out) + "\n")
    print(
        f"wrote {out_path} ({out_path.stat().st_size} bytes); "
        f"{len(messages)} messages, {counts.get('tool_use', 0)} tool calls, "
        f"{counts.get('thinking', 0)} thinking blocks; assets in {assets}"
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))

def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    args = [a for a in argv[1:] if not a.startswith("--")]
    if len(args) == 2:
        messages_path, out_path = Path(args[0]), Path(args[1])
        session_path = None
    elif len(args) == 3:
        messages_path, session_path, out_path = Path(args[0]), Path(args[1]), Path(args[2])
    else:
        print(__doc__)
        return 2

    data = json.loads(messages_path.read_text())
    session = json.loads(session_path.read_text()) if session_path else {}
    messages = data.get("messages") or []
    stem = out_path.stem
    assets = out_path.parent / f"{stem}.assets"
    assets.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    asset_prefix = f"{stem}.assets/"

    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    tokens = {"in": 0, "out": 0, "cacheRead": 0, "cacheWrite": 0}
    for m in messages:
        for b in m.get("content") or []:
            if isinstance(b, dict):
                counts[b.get("type", "?")] = counts.get(b.get("type", "?"), 0) + 1
        mm = m.get("metrics") or {}
        tokens["in"] += mm.get("inputTokens") or 0
        tokens["out"] += mm.get("outputTokens") or 0
        tokens["cacheRead"] += mm.get("cacheReadTokens") or 0
        tokens["cacheWrite"] += mm.get("cacheWriteTokens") or 0

    out: list[str] = []
    out.append(f"# Chat transcript — {stem}\n")
    out.append(
        "Verbatim session record, saved from the CLI session store "
        f"(`{messages_path.name}`). Nothing here is paraphrased: the system prompt, "
        "the user prompts, every assistant reasoning block, and every tool call "
        "with its full result are reproduced in order.\n"
    )
    out.append("## Session\n")
    out.append("| field | value |")
    out.append("| --- | --- |")
    rows = [
        ("session id", data.get("sessionId") or session.get("session_id")),
        ("source", session.get("source")),
        ("cwd", session.get("cwd")),
        ("workspace root", session.get("workspace_root")),
        ("started at", session.get("started_at")),
        ("last write to store", data.get("updated_at")),
        ("provider / model", f"{session.get('provider')} / {session.get('model')}"),
        ("status at snapshot", session.get("status")),
        ("messages", len(messages)),
        ("blocks", ", ".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in sorted(counts.items()))),
        (
            "assistant tokens",
            "in {inp}, out {out}, cache read {cr}, cache write {cw}".format(
                inp=tokens["in"],
                out=tokens["out"],
                cr=tokens["cacheRead"],
                cw=tokens["cacheWrite"],
            ),
        ),
    ]
    for label, value in rows:
        if value not in (None, ""):
            out.append(f"| {label} | `{value}` |")
    out.append("")

    if session.get("prompt"):
        out.append("## Opening prompt\n")
        out.append(code_block(str(session["prompt"]), "text"))

    if data.get("system_prompt"):
        out.append("## System prompt\n")
        out.append("<details><summary>Full system prompt as sent to the model</summary>\n")
        out.append(code_block(data["system_prompt"], "text"))
        out.append("</details>\n")

    out.append("## Conversation\n")
    for idx, message in enumerate(messages, start=1):
        role = message.get("role", "?")
        out.append(f"### {idx}. {role}\n")
        meta_bits = []
        if message.get("ts"):
            meta_bits.append(fmt_ts(message["ts"]))
        line = emit_metrics(message)
        if line:
            meta_bits.append(line)
        if meta_bits:
            out.append(" · ".join(meta_bits) + "\n")

        for j, block in enumerate(message.get("content") or []):
            if not isinstance(block, dict):
                out.append(code_block(str(block), "text"))
                continue
            btype = block.get("type")
            if btype == "text":
                out.append(block.get("text") or "")
                out.append("")
            elif btype == "thinking":
                out.append("**🧠 thinking**\n")
                out.append(code_block(block.get("thinking") or "", "thinking"))
            elif btype == "tool_use":
                out.append(
                    f"**🔧 tool call — `{block.get('name')}`** "
                    f"(id `{block.get('id')}`)\n"
                )
                out.append(
                    code_block(
                        json.dumps(block.get("input"), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                        "json",
                    )
                )
            elif btype == "tool_result":
                out.append(
                    f"**📥 tool result — `{block.get('name')}`** "
                    f"(for `{block.get('tool_use_id')}`)\n"
                )
                out.extend(
                    render_result_content(
                        block.get("content"),
                        assets,
                        asset_prefix,
                        f"{stem}-m{idx}-b{j}",
                    )
                )
            else:
                out.append(code_block(json.dumps(block, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "json"))

        bad = (message.get("metadata") or {}).get("invalidToolCalls")
        if bad:
            out.append(f"**⚠️ {len(bad)} invalid/rejected tool call(s) in this turn**\n")
            out.append(code_block(json.dumps(bad, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "json"))

    out_path.write_text("\n".join(out) + "\n")
    print(
        f"wrote {out_path} ({out_path.stat().st_size} bytes); "
        f"{len(messages)} messages, {counts.get('tool_use', 0)} tool calls, "
        f"{counts.get('thinking', 0)} thinking blocks; assets in {assets}"
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv))
